scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install --include=dev && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.github: git add . && git commit -m "update: synchronisation automatique" && git push origin main
scripts.rebrand: echo 'Editez server/config.json pour rebrander toute lagence de maniere dynamique.'
